people.name: Hugh Dowding
people.nameZh: 第一代道丁男爵休·道丁

body.zh-Hant: 休·道丁（1882—1970）生於蘇格蘭莫法特，先後就讀聖尼尼安學校與溫徹斯特公學，再入伍爾維奇的皇家軍事學院。他早年在皇家駐防炮兵於海外服役，第一次世界大戰開始時加入皇家飛行團，1915年出任第16中隊指揮官。
body.en: Hugh Dowding (1882–1970) was born in Moffat, Scotland, and was educated at St Ninian’s School and Winchester College, followed by the Royal Military Academy, Woolwich. He served abroad in the Royal Garrison Artillery, joined the Royal Flying Corps at the start of the First World War, and in 1915 became commanding officer of 16 Squadron.

heading.zh-Hant: 轉入皇家空軍與戰鬥機司令部
heading.en: Royal Air Force and Fighter Command

body.zh-Hant: 他在一戰結束時已是准將，其後轉入新成立的皇家空軍，1933年獲頒巴斯勳章爵級司令。1936年他出任戰鬥機司令部總司令，原定1939年退休，卻被要求留任。自1936年起，他便向內閣與空軍委員會陳述，下一場戰爭英國將處於守勢，因此應優先增產戰鬥機；他也強調要改善對敵機的偵測與預警。
body.en: He finished the First World War as a brigadier-general and transferred to the new RAF, receiving the Knight Commander of the Order of the Bath in 1933. In 1936 he was made commander-in-chief of Fighter Command and, though due to retire in 1939, was asked to continue. From 1936 he argued to the cabinet and Air Council that Britain would be on the defensive in the next war, so fighter strength should be built up first, and he stressed better detection and early warning of enemy aircraft.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年5月，道丁在一份言詞有力的備忘錄中懇求不要再把戰鬥機送往法國。其後的不列顛戰役主要發生在1940年7月10日至10月31日之間，他全程親自掌控。邱吉爾稱他保留七個中隊作預備隊的決定是戰爭藝術中的天才之例。
body.en: In May 1940 Dowding begged, in a powerfully argued memo, that no more fighter planes be sent to France. The Battle of Britain that followed occurred primarily between 10 July and 31 October 1940, and he was in personal control throughout. Churchill called his decision to hold seven squadrons in reserve an example of genius in the art of war.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年11月，在德國入侵的威脅被擊退之後，道丁被撤換；他於1942年自皇家空軍退役，並在1943年7月5日受封為道丁男爵。此後他把餘生投入唯靈論與反對活體解剖的運動，並於1970年2月15日去世。
body.en: He was replaced in November 1940, after the German invasion threat had been defeated; he retired from the RAF in 1942 and was made Baron Dowding on 5 July 1943. He devoted the rest of his life to spiritualism and to campaigning against vivisection, and died on 15 February 1970.

people.name: Archibald Wavell, 1st Earl Wavell
people.nameZh: 第一代韋維爾伯爵阿奇博爾德·韋維爾

heading.zh-Hant: 中東總司令與義大利參戰
heading.en: Middle East command and Italy's entry

body.zh-Hant: 韋維爾在1939至1941年間擔任英軍中東總司令。1940年6月10日義大利對英法宣戰，他手中只有約六萬三千人要防衛埃及、巴勒斯坦、外約旦與伊拉克，而義大利在利比亞的兵力遠為龐大。
body.en: Wavell was commander in chief of British forces in the Middle East from 1939 to 1941. When Italy declared war on 10 June 1940, he had only some sixty-three thousand men to protect Egypt, Palestine, Trans-Jordan and Iraq, while Italy had a much larger military presence in Libya.

citations.locator: EBSCO Research Starters「Second Battle of El Alamein」
citations.quote: (1883-1950), commander in chief of British forces in the Middle East, 1939-1941
Italy declared war on France and England on June 10
Wavell had only sixty-threee thousand men
while Italy had a much larger military presence in Libya

heading.zh-Hant: 指南針行動與東非攻勢

body.zh-Hant: 1940年12月9日英軍發動「指南針行動」，奧康納所部在拂曉突襲尼貝瓦的設防營地，步兵、裝甲與砲兵配合井然。1941年2月6日至9日的貝達福姆戰役使義大利第十軍告終。同時，韋維爾在義屬東非的攻勢於1941年1月19日展開；他的部隊在1940與1941年間把義軍逐出利比亞與衣索比亞。
body.en: Operation Compass began on 9 December 1940, when O’Connor’s men hit the fortified camp at Nibeiwa at daybreak with artillery, armor and infantry attacking in perfect order. The battle of Beda Fomm, fought hard between 6 and 9 February 1941, ended the Italian Tenth Army. Wavell’s offensive into Italian East Africa began on 19 January 1941, and his forces drove the Italians out of Libya and Ethiopia in 1940–1941.

citations.quote: Dubbed Operation Compass, the British attack began on December 9.
Hitting the Nibeiwa fortified camp at daybreak
O’Connor’s men produced a textbook example for the combined arms attack
Artillery, armor, and infantry attacked in perfect order
Despite hard fighting between February 6 and 9, 1941
this battle marked the end of the Tenth Army
which began on January 19, 1941

citations.locator: EBSCO Research Starters「Second Battle of El Alamein」
citations.quote: drove them out of Libya and Ethiopia

heading.zh-Hant: 希臘遠征、戰斧行動與去職

body.zh-Hant: 邱吉爾命令韋維爾組成遠征軍援助希臘人，並在1941年3月下令增派英軍赴希臘。五月中旬，韋維爾在邱吉爾支持下策劃「戰斧行動」，企圖突破到托布魯克，卻被隆美爾輕易擊退，損失逾半裝甲。夏季期間，他被奧金萊克取代。
body.en: Churchill ordered Wavell to form an expeditionary force to aid the Greeks and in March 1941 ordered more British forces sent to Greece. In mid-May Wavell, backed by Churchill, planned Operation Battleaxe to break through to Tobruk; Rommel easily repulsed him and destroyed more than half the British armor. During the summer Wavell was replaced by Claude Auchinleck.

heading.en: Viceroy of India and later years

body.zh-Hant: 韋維爾自1943年起任印度總督，任期至1947年。孟加拉大饑荒期間，他前往孟加拉並展開積極行動以減輕災情。1943年7月22日他受封韋維爾子爵，1947年5月1日晉為伯爵，1950年5月24日去世。
body.en: From 1943 Wavell was viceroy of India, until 1947. During the Bengal famine he travelled to Bengal and began a vigorous effort to mitigate its effects. He became Viscount Wavell on 22 July 1943 and Earl Wavell on 1 May 1947, and died on 24 May 1950.

people.nameZh: 第一代黑格伯爵道格拉斯·黑格

body.zh-Hant: 道格拉斯·黑格1861年6月19日生於蘇格蘭愛丁堡，是英國軍官。1914年之前，他已被公認為同代最傑出的軍人之一。
body.en: Douglas Haig was born in Edinburgh, Scotland, on 19 June 1861, a British officer. Before 1914 he was recognised as one of the outstanding soldiers of his generation.

body.en: Haig was a cavalryman who served in the Sudan in 1898 and in the Boer War, and afterwards until 1912 mainly in India. The French Ministry of the Armed Forces page adds that in 1906 he became Director of Military Training at the War Office, the youngest major-general in the British army.

body.zh-Hant: 1915年12月，黑格接替約翰·弗倫奇，出任駐法英軍總司令。他指揮了1916年的索姆河攻勢，以及1917年的阿拉斯與法蘭德斯攻勢，這些戰役以傷亡慘重著稱，並被列為英國史上代價最高也最具爭議的戰役。黑格於1917年晉升陸軍元帥。
body.en: In December 1915 Haig replaced Sir John French as commander-in-chief of the British armies in France. He led the bloody offensives at the Somme in 1916 and at Arras and in Flanders in 1917, which were among the most costly and controversial battles in British history. He became a field marshal in 1917.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年8月至11月，黑格發動的戰役終於擊潰德軍的抵抗，被認為比索姆河與帕森達勒的戰役成功得多；在戰爭的最後階段，這些行動是在法國元帥福煦的最高指揮之下進行。對黑格的評價仍充滿爭議，他在大眾心目中的形象是冷酷的屠夫。
body.en: The campaign Haig waged between August and November 1918 finally broke the German army’s resistance and was far more successful than the Somme or Passchendaele; in the closing phase the operations were under the supreme command of the French marshal Ferdinand Foch. Haig remains a figure of great controversy, and his popular image is that of a callous butcher.

body.zh-Hant: 第六代戈特子爵約翰·維里克1886年7月10日生於倫敦，是一名英國軍官，1943年獲任命為陸軍元帥，1946年3月31日在倫敦南華克去世。
body.en: John Vereker, 6th Viscount Gort, was born in London on 10 July 1886. A British officer, he was appointed field marshal in 1943 and died in Southwark on 31 March 1946.

heading.zh-Hant: 帝國總參謀長與英國遠征軍
heading.en: Imperial General Staff and the BEF

body.zh-Hant: 戈特（全名約翰·斯坦迪什·薩蒂斯·普倫德加斯特·維里克，1886—1946）1937至1939年擔任英帝國總參謀長。第二次世界大戰期間，他在1939至1940年間統率英國的整個野戰軍，即英國遠征軍。
body.en: From 1937 to 1939 Gort (John Standish Surtees Prendergast Vereker, 1886–1946) was head of the British Imperial General Staff. In the Second World War he commanded the entire British field army, the British Expeditionary Force, from 1939 to 1940.

citations.quote: Fra 1937 til 1939 var han sjef for det britiske imperiets generalstab.
sjef for den samlede britiske feltarmé fra 1939 til 1940
General Lord Gort, the commander in chief of the British Expeditionary Force
(John Standish Surtees Prendergast Vereker; 1886–1946)

body.zh-Hant: 德軍迅速推進使戈特深感不安；早在5月19日，他就通知英國政府，他正考慮把所部九個師撤往英吉利海峽沿岸以便可能的撤離。他領導了艱難的敦克爾克撤退戰役。
body.en: The German advance seriously alarmed Gort: as early as 19 May he informed the British government that he was considering withdrawing his nine divisions to the English Channel for possible evacuation. He led the difficult evacuation from Dunkirk.

body.zh-Hant: 1942至1943年，戈特領導馬爾他抵禦德義聯軍頻繁的空襲。1944至1945年，他擔任巴勒斯坦與外約旦的高級專員。
body.en: In 1942–1943 Gort led the defence of Malta against the numerous German-Italian air attacks. In 1944–1945 he was High Commissioner for Palestine and Transjordan.

body.zh-Hant: 艾倫·布魯克1883年7月23日生於法國，雙親屬於愛爾蘭的新教統治階層。他進入伍爾維奇皇家軍事學院，1902年受任皇家野戰炮兵軍官，1909年獲准轉入皇家騎炮兵。
body.en: Alan Brooke was born in France on 23 July 1883; both his parents belonged to the Protestant Ascendancy class in Ireland. He entered the Royal Military Academy, Woolwich, was commissioned in the Royal Field Artillery in 1902 and in 1909 was accepted into the Royal Horse Artillery.

body.zh-Hant: 一戰期間，布魯克在法國主戰線服役，炮兵指揮被評為傑出；大戰結束時，他已獲傑出服務勳章及其加杖。1919年他入選戰後第一期參謀學院課程，1929年出任炮兵學校校長。
body.en: During the First World War Brooke served on the main front in France, where his handling of artillery was rated outstanding, and by the war's end he had won the Distinguished Service Order and bar. He was selected for the first postwar Army Staff College course in 1919 and was appointed Commandant of the School of Artillery in 1929.

body.zh-Hant: 1939年8月，布魯克受任南方司令部總司令，開戰後該司令部改組為英國遠征軍第二軍；同年9月他指揮其中一個軍。1940年德軍攻勢使英軍退向敦克爾克，布魯克指揮第二軍在艱難的退入敦克爾克防線期間表現出色，隨後被派去在索姆河以南重建新的遠征軍，並力主撤出留在法國的英軍，約十四萬英軍在這第二次撤離中返國。
body.en: In August 1939 Brooke was appointed commander in chief, Southern Command, which on the outbreak of war became the Second Army Corps of the British Expeditionary Force; in September 1939 he commanded one of the two British corps in France. In 1940 he commanded the corps with distinction during the difficult withdrawal into the Dunkirk perimeter, was then asked to build up a new BEF south of the Somme, and urged the withdrawal of the remaining British troops; nearly 140,000 got home in this second evacuation.

body.zh-Hant: 1940年7月，布魯克出任本土軍總司令，負責擊敗預期中的德國入侵，但入侵並未發生。1941年底，邱吉爾請他接任帝國總參謀長；1942年3月，他又成為參謀長委員會主席，實際上成為英國最主要的軍事發言人。
body.en: In July 1940 Brooke was appointed commander in chief of the home forces to defeat the anticipated German invasion of England, which never came. In late 1941 Churchill asked him to become Chief of the Imperial General Staff, and in March 1942 he became chair of the Chiefs of Staff Committee, in effect Britain's leading military spokesman.

body.zh-Hant: 布魯克主張先在北非與義大利削弱德軍，再登陸西北歐；盟軍於1942年底進入西北非，1943年攻入西西里與義大利，1944年6月才在西北歐登陸。邱吉爾1943年初曾許諾由他指揮登陸西北歐，但最終必須由美國人出任統帥。他1944年晉升陸軍元帥，1945年封男爵，1946年封子爵。他於1963年6月17日在漢普郡去世。
body.en: Brooke favoured weakening the German army in Africa and Italy before landing in northwest Europe: Anglo-American forces entered northwest Africa in late 1942, invaded Sicily and Italy in 1943 and landed in northwest Europe in June 1944. Churchill had promised him the invasion command in early 1943, but an American commander proved inevitable. Brooke was raised to field marshal in 1944, created Baron Alanbrooke in 1945 and Viscount Alanbrooke in 1946, and died in Hampshire on 17 June 1963.
